top_band: none (rows 1-4 on the upper chimney cap and row 14 on the brick hearth are flat front-elevation bands/ledges without a 3/4 horizontal top surface)
evidence: The main body is the lower brick forge hearth (rows 14-31), which begins immediately with a vertical brick wall pattern at row 14 with no horizontal top surface visible above it. The upper hood/chimney (rows 0-13) also shows only a flat front cap (rows 1-5) rather than a 3/4 top opening or roof slope.

style.evidence: The stonework and metal hood use simple geometric bands of 2-3 flat grey tones with uniform dark outlines and lack the rich multi-step per-stone shading and surface speckle of the Beodeul references.
